channel.title: Adithyan Prakash — AI & ML Engineering Notes

item.title: TIL: Why pin_memory=True in PyTorch Caused Intermittent CUDA Bus Errors
item.description: A 2-minute debugging war story on memory locking, Linux /dev/shm exhaustion, and how pin_memory=True can crash multi-worker DataLoaders.

item.title: Architecting a Sub-40ms Edge Vision Pipeline for 90+ Live Camera Feeds

item.title: Building Deterministic LLM Pipelines with Zero Hallucinations
item.description: How we replaced flaky, unconstrained prompt-chains with grammar-guided generation, strict JSON schemas, and deterministic validation loops.
